partnership_angle: Effectively none of the boutique entry motions fit anymore. CompliancePoint (including its assurance arm's parent org) was acquired by Wipfli, a top-25 national accounting firm, effective May 1, 2026 — so this is now a big-firm channel, which the client explicitly excludes. On top of that, the parent sells its own SOC 2 readiness services (now backed by Wipfli's advisory bench), meaning LoxeAI's readiness scan competes directly with their in-house revenue line rather than complementing it. If pursued at all, the only angle is a low-priority sandbox-tester relationship with Carol Amick personally to gather auditor feedback on scan output quality — not a referral pipeline.
pitch_note: Not recommended for outreach under the Tester→Validator→Design Partner strategy: post-Wipfli acquisition, referral decisions route through a top-25 firm's partnership machinery, and their own readiness consulting practice is the exact service LoxeAI automates. If contact is made anyway, position narrowly to Carol Amick as a no-cost technical validation exercise: 'Run a LoxeAI scan against a sandbox AWS environment and tell us where the evidence falls short of what your audit team needs' — useful product feedback, but do not expect them to tell pre-audit clients to run the scan when their parent firm sells that readiness work.
